Instrument.name: The Rosetta Plasme Consortium (RPC) Langmuir Probe (LAP) for the Rosetta Orbiter
Instrument.description: The Langmuir Probe (LAP) element of the RPC consisted of two spherical probes of radius 25mm, mounted on booms of different lengths (2.24m and 1.62m), referred to as "LAP1" and "LAP2", or just "P1" and "P2". With a wide variety of operational modes, the LAP planned to measure plasma density, electron temperature, spacecraft potential, plasma drift speed, and plasma fluctuations and waves up to 8 kHz.
